'''Zonsoe''' was a member of the [[Blazing Chain]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-using organization. Zonsoe was the [[Adacap]], or leader, of the Blazing Chain [[Blackshackle]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Around [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], Zonsoe fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and led the Blackshackle fleet on attacks against the other Blazing Chain fleets. Although Zonsoe succeeded in defeating the [[Arcblade]] fleet, Zonsoe and the Blackshackle fleet were eventually defeated.<ref name="TUR" />
